items.title: OpenSSH GSSAPI Vulnerability Allow an Attacker to Crash SSH Child Processes
items.description: A significant vulnerability in the GSSAPI Key Exchange patch was applied by numerous Linux distributions on top of their OpenSSH packages. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-3497, was uncovered by security researcher Jeremy Brown. items.title: Delinea's StrongDM Acquisition Highlights the Changing Role of PAM
items.description: StrongDM, which injects ephemeral, real-time credentials into developer workflows, will enable Delinea to offer privilege access management across cloud, SaaS, Kubernetes, and database environments.
